# Vendored slidem

Built output of [ruphin/slidem](https://github.com/ruphin/slidem) at commit
`6c9f720` (an unpublished slidem 3 pre-release), with local uncommitted changes
from the working tree at the time of vendoring.

To update: run `npm run build` in a slidem checkout, then copy `dist/`,
`package.json`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE` and `README.md` here and update the
commit above.
